title: Generic guidance (no tooling assumed)
note: Tool-neutral next steps. Organisations replace or extend this pack with their own automation.

ci.title: Extend the CI pipeline
ci.does: Add the missing stage or job to the existing CI system and make it a required check.

tests.title: Add the missing tests
tests.does: Write the tests in the team's existing framework and run them in CI.

scan.title: Run a vulnerability scan
scan.does: Run the organisation's approved scanner against the repository and record the result.

upgrade.title: Plan a platform upgrade
upgrade.does: Run change impact for the target version, then upgrade behind the test safety net.

deploy_config.title: Change the deployment configuration
deploy_config.does: Update the Kubernetes, Helm or Nomad files (or the platform repository that owns them).

app_config.title: Change the application configuration
app_config.does: Update the application's configuration and verify in a non-production environment.

docs.title: Document it in the repository
docs.does: Add the missing file (README, CODEOWNERS, ADR) next to the code.

deps_bot.title: Turn on dependency update pull requests
deps_bot.does: Add a Renovate or Dependabot configuration so outdated dependencies arrive as reviewed pull requests.

alias.title: Resolve unmatched calls
alias.does: Add the missing repositories to the analysis, or supply an alias file (host: application), then re-run.
